<div class="card-body">
'''Run Luke, Run!''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">走れ、ルーク、走るんだ！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：隣接する位置で戦闘が宣言された時に使う。フォースの消費なしで、ルークをその位置へ移動させる。ベイダーがその戦闘に参加しているか、戦闘が行われる位置の隣接位置に配備されていない限り、その戦闘中、ルークの戦闘力は＋２となる。２：「ベイダーの執念」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Run-Luke-Run-SWCA-97588.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ベイダーがオビ＝ワンを倒すのを見て、ルークは我を忘れてブラスターを乱射した。老ジェダイ・マスターの、「走れ、ルーク、走るんだ！」という声を聞いて正気に戻るまで。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Run, Luke, Run!

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when a battle is declared at an adjacent site. Move Luke there without using Force. Unless Vader is in that battle or deployed at a site adjacent to the battle, Luke is power +2 for that battle. 2: Cancel “Vader's Obsession”.

'''Lore:''' Seeing Vader strike down Obi-Wan, Luke lost himself and fired his blaster wildly, until the old Jedi Master's voice, “Run, Luke, run!”, brought him back to his senses.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Run Luke, Run!]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
